meta.coverage: The RBI's weekly statement of affairs: liabilities and assets of the Issue and Banking Departments, every week since July 2004
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 20 (data provider DP4), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (17 values, e.g. Banking Department, Assets, Central Government on 2022-04-15; Banking Department, Assets, Central Government on 2022-05-20; Banking Department, Assets, NABARD on 2023-03-24).
